headline: Air France-KLM Flying Blue Promo Rewards Offer 25% Off Select Award Tickets, Including Business Class to NYC
reasoning: This topic is highly relevant for travelers, offering a direct opportunity to save significantly on flights using points and miles. The information is actionable and timely, detailing specific routes and booking windows for July 2026, and comes from a credible travel deals publication. The inclusion of business class discounts to a major US hub makes it particularly valuable.
summary: Air France-KLM's Flying Blue program has released its July 2026 Promo Rewards, offering 25% discounts on select award tickets for travel through December 31, 2026, including business class from Europe to New York for 45,000 miles.

source_articles.title: Air France-KLM Flying Blue Promo Rewards: Save 25% On Select Awards
source_articles.excerpt: The Air France-KLM Flying Blue program has its monthly Promo Rewards promotion, whereby members can save 25% on select award tickets over a limited travel period. The program has just published its new Promo Rewards list for July 2026, offering discounted short haul and long haul awards for travel over the coming months.
